title: The Count of Monte Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
summary: Edmond Dantès is falsely accused on the eve of his wedding and imprisoned for years in an island fortress. After escaping with a fortune, he returns to Paris under a new name to repay those who betrayed him.
readIf: you want a huge, page-turning adventure about betrayal, patience and an elaborate revenge.
skipIf: you want a short book, since the plot is intricate and the cast is big.

pairings.reason: Another giant French novel about a wronged man, with more compassion and less scheming.
By the same author, a faster, more cheerful swashbuckler.
A funny, lighter story with a similar love of sword fights, revenge and a very long plan.
